about: UCT Agent E2E BENCH v1 (2026-11-23, pl-e2e): scored END TO END on the final board (testing/e2eEval.jsx), never teacher-forced. Eight classes, written fresh as classes (no production sentence reused): pane-multistep (multi-step with an indicator pane edit), ticker-correction (a correction whose first word is also a ticker), pane-conflict (a pane resize whose save the server refuses with a 409 revision conflict; host.conflict), correction-branch (dialogues whose second line depends on what the first turn did); v1.1 (11-23): exclusion (all/every ... except, everything but, leave X alone, negated relative clauses), followup-correction, targeting (a chart named by what it shows or where it sits); v1.2 (11-24, marked new): side-by-side, to the owner 11-23 ruling (preserve and add; ask when ambiguous), compared by meaning (compare: semantic). Expectation fields beyond the bench format: from: "start" (the final board is compared with the dialogue's first board + these ops), blocked (actions whose save is refused), branch: { success | wrongChart | ask | fail: turn }, host: { conflict }. Fixture tickers and numbers only.
